blocks.text: Comments from Balcony 3.0 beta testers, newest first. 41 testers enrolled.
Offline mode saved me in the basement. Did six inspections down there with no signal and they all showed up when I came back up. (Inspector, Ohio)
Photo upload slow on hotel wifi. It got there eventually but I watched it for a while. (Site lead, Texas)
Love the signed report. Our safety lead asked where it came from. (Warehouse manager, Georgia)
Wish I could search past inspections. I know I did dock 3 last month and I can't find it. (Inspector, Arizona)
Camera crashed twice on my old tablet on Tuesday. Sent reports from Settings. (Inspector, Oregon)
Signing on the device is quick. Two taps and done. (Inspector, Kansas)
The new inspection form is faster to fill in than 2.x. Fewer screens. (Site lead, Nevada)
Background upload means I don't wait around at the end of a shift anymore. (Inspector, Iowa)
